{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Maintaining American preeminence requires a world-class system of education in which all students can reach their potential.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Since 1965, the federal government has spent $2 trillion on elementary and secondary education through more than 100 programs in the Department of Education.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Despite $2 trillion in federal spending since 1965, there has been little substantial improvement in academic achievement or high school graduation rates.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The United States spends an average of more than $12,000 per pupil per year in public schools.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The United States spends a total of more than $620 billion on public schools.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"K-12 education represented more than 4 percent of GDP in 2011-2012.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Federal spending on education amounted to more than $57 billion.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"If money were the solution, schools would be problem-free.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"More money alone does not necessarily equal better performance.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Choice in education, building on the basics, STEM subjects and phonics, career and technical education, ending social promotions, merit pay for good teachers, classroom discipline, parental involvement, and strong leadership by principals, superintendents, and locally elected school boards have made a difference in student advancement.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Technology must be a key element in efforts to provide every child equal access and opportunity.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Instruction in American history and civics should use the original documents of the founding fathers.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
